business_problem: After being formed from the merger of five pharmaceutical solution providers, Norstella needed to separate from a parent environment, migrate 23 AWS accounts, and stand up a governed enterprise cloud platform quickly without disrupting business operations.
solution_summary: Norstella used AWS Control Tower to build a secure multiaccount cloud environment from scratch and complete a complex carve-out migration in under five months. The company had to disentangle 23 AWS accounts from its former parent while simultaneously creating a scalable foundation for the combined business. Working with AWS and GlobalLogic through the AWS Migration Acceleration Program, Norstella standardized planning, governance, and landing-zone setup, then moved to an infrastructure-as-code operating model so its central DevOps team could provision accounts, pipelines, and future acquisitions more consistently. The resulting platform is not just a one-time migration destination: it is the governed operating layer for ongoing automation, cost optimization, and future adoption of services such as Amazon Bedrock, giving Norstella faster environment delivery and a simpler path to innovation.

solution_components.role: Provides the secure multiaccount landing zone and governance framework for Norstella's enterprise cloud environment.

data_flow: Norstella migrated 23 AWS accounts into a new AWS Control Tower-governed environment, then used infrastructure-as-code automation to provision additional accounts, pipelines, and future acquisitions more quickly from the centralized DevOps model.
